description: This file serves as a compatibility shim during migration to the 'torch.ao.quantization' package, re-exporting functions from 'torch.ao.quantization.fx.utils'. It contains import statements for various utility functions related to quantization in PyTorch's FX framework.

methods.name: all_node_args_have_no_tensors
methods.description: Checks whether all arguments of a node are non-tensor values.

methods.name: assert_and_get_unique_device
methods.description: Asserts and retrieves the unique device from a set of tensors or arguments.

methods.name: create_getattr_from_value
methods.description: Creates an attribute accessor for a given value within a module.

methods.name: get_custom_module_class_keys
methods.description: Retrieves keys for custom module classes involved in the graph.

methods.name: get_linear_prepack_op_for_dtype
methods.description: Obtains the prepack operator for linear layers based on dtype.

methods.name: get_new_attr_name_with_prefix
methods.description: Generates a new attribute name with a given prefix.

methods.name: get_non_observable_arg_indexes_and_types
methods.description: Determines argument indexes and types that are non-observable.

methods.name: get_qconv_prepack_op
methods.description: Retrieves the prepack operator for quantized convolution.

methods.name: graph_module_from_producer_nodes
methods.description: Constructs a graph module from producer nodes.

methods.name: maybe_get_next_module
methods.description: Attempts to get the next module in a sequence, if available.
